baseline: FD:L2736-2760 (BR19a, BR19b, BR19c), FD:L1129-1155 (bucket, pendingReads), FD:L4855-4862 (BridgeBucket, check, RpcReadClient).

messageLiteral.oversize(i): P: {"id":i,"kind":"rpc_read","payload":{"method":"eth_blockNumber","params":["aaa..."]}} padded to exactly 65537 UTF-8 bytes

traceTokensBefore: P: BridgeTrace tokensBefore_mt is the stored tokens_mt before the refill for this message. A size-rejected message does not touch the bucket, so the next line's tokensBefore_mt equals its own (FD:L2690).

rows.note: the bucket is not refilled or touched by size rejections

BR19a.a7: every BridgeTrace line carries tokensBefore_mt equal to the model's stored value before the message (checked for all 265 lines)
BR19a.negativeControl: bridge-fault:noRefill must fail a3 (tokens stay 0 at 1020 -> rate)

BR19b.setup: RpcReadClient with FakeTransport (holds replies until released) and FakeClock; frame f1 in session S with pendingReads 0; inputs already passed check.

steps.do: release the reply of request 1; then a 6th eth_call
advance the clock 10000 ms without replies
eth_getLogs via LogClient.fetchAll (MockLogServer holds; 3 internal requests), then 4 x eth_call
fresh frame f2 with 4 pending reads; tear f2 down; new frame f3 in the same session reads once; settle one orphan; f3 reads again

script: TestHooks opens a fresh session for BadSite (full bucket); RpcTap.serve in front of anvil-br (chainId 777910); RpcTap.hold('eth_call', 3000)
BadSite sends, in one synchronous loop without waiting, 60 messages m(1)..m(60) (rpc_read eth_blockNumber)
2000 ms after the loop it sends 5 messages {"id":61..65,"kind":"rpc_read","payload":{"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<s2>"},"latest"]}}
Collect BridgeTrace (arrivalMs, decisions) and the RpcTap log (tIn, tOut per forwarded request)
BR19c.matching: G: every BridgeTrace decision equals the BridgeRef decision computed from the recorded arrivalMs and reply times; the set of RpcTap requests equals the set of messages BridgeRef routes; zero requests for rejected messages (FD:L2758).
BR19c.decisionRule: Decisive if BridgeRef predicts at least one rate rejection among the 60 and at least one pending rejection among the 5; otherwise repeat up to 3 times, then 'inconclusive' with the recorded arrival intervals (FD:L2759). No fixed count such as 50/10 is expected (FD:L2760).

syntheticTrace.label: P: a reference trace to exercise BridgeRef itself (not a browser run): arrivals of m(1)..m(60) at 1000+j ms (j = 0..59); RpcTap replies to eth_blockNumber 5 ms after forwarding; the 5 eth_call arrive at 3000 ms; their replies are held until 6000 ms.
